messages:
sam: quick note — seeing a small but sharp uptick in 5xxs for embeddings in eu-central since the quant rollout at 02:12 UTC. p99 increasing ~28%. recommend emergency revert to v2.2.6 for eu-central only.
ida: can you share the telemetry link?
sam: https://telemetry.redwood/prod/embeds?region=eu-central spike aligns with image embed:v2.3.0-quant
sre_lead: we need an expedited plan: canary slices, abort criteria, rollback cmd, owner, and a changelog entry.
release_manager: I can approve expedited label if SRE signs off. owner please volunteer.
ida: I'll own it. proposal: staged canary 1% -> 5% -> 50% -> 100% with manual approval gates. abort if 5xx > 0.4% or p99 regresses > 20% for 5m.
sre_lead: approve for canary. ensure extra alerting and ops on-call watching.
release_manager: draft release note:
```n
Hotfix (expedited): revert embeddings image in eu-central from v2.3.0-quant to v2.2.6 to mitigate p99 tail latency and elevated 5xx rate. No schema changes; config change: batching window -> 18ms.
```n
ida: deploybot, start hotpatch: service=embeddings region=eu-central from=v2.3.0-quant to=v2.2.6 owner=ida
deploybot: @ida initiated deploy id=dr-1767993333-a. strategy=staged-canary slices=[1%,5%,50%,100%]; checks=[health,p95,p99,5xx]; manual approval between slices.
ops: infra check ok for staged slices. prepping routing and extra logs.
ida: canary 1% started (dr-1767993333-a). watching p50/p95/p99 and 5xx.
ida: 6m: p95 -10%, p99 -21%, 5xx back to baseline. approve 5%.
deploybot: progressing to 5% slice.
ops: notifying impacted customers in case they want to opt-in to updates.
ida: 10m at 5% stable. green to 50%.
sre_lead: approved 50% step. monitoring bright.
deploybot: advancing to 50%.
ida: 12m at 50% stable. proceeding to 100%.
deploybot: deploy complete dr-1767993333-a -> 100% status=success.
release_manager: tagging this hotfix as expedited-critical in changelog and billing. posting a short incident note.
sre_lead: rollback (one-liner):
```n
kubectl -n prod rollout undo deploy/embeddings --to-revision=deploy-v2.3.0-quant && kubectl rollout status -n prod deploy/embeddings
```n
ida: follow-ups: create RCA ticket, add regression test for long-seq quant paths, evaluate canary automation for tail regressions. closing thread once RCA link posted. :thumbsup:
